Two 512-cell signed cubical product tori have identically zero integer boundaries; their 2x2 coordinate evaluation is identity, so they generate the rank-two integer kernel primitively. The subdivision criterion holds for k=3; verifier recomputes every arithmetic input with exact operations.

value.rationale: This identifies the first appearance of genuinely three-dimensional collision-free motion on a natural family of cubic prism graphs and produces a canonical pair of primitive geometric three-tori. The sharp cutoff through circumferences three to six is mathematically motivated by maximal sets of disjoint lateral square faces and is not an arbitrary parameter slice; all smaller cases are included. The precise integral generators give stronger and reusable information than a Betti number alone. This is a finite exact theorem, without an unproved all-order claim.
